ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.3
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Optional diagnostics companion for RimMT. v0.3 adds per-DetermineNextJob WorkGiver correlation for >=20 ms calls plus detailed HaulMerge and Pather Harmony authority audit, on top of live current-Wait census, sampled Pather/WorkGiver attribution, ReachProfile Region.Allows capture timing, pause/resume markers and world-component timing. Measurement-only: disable this mod for normal gameplay when diagnostics are not needed.
